build_transformer_encoder: build a stacked transformer encoder with configurable layers, heads, and hidden dimensions
create_dot_product_attention: create dot-product self-attention with query, key, value projections and capped softmax
create_attention_token_pooling: create an attention-based token pooling layer that aggregates sequence embeddings into fixed-size vectors
create_transformer_ffn: create a transformer feed-forward block with layer normalization, two FFN layers, and residual connection
create_layer_norm: create a layer normalization module with optional scale and bias parameters
